name: branding-liquid-blob-wordmark-apparel
title: Melting blob wordmark on a knit beanie and a black card on crumpled plastic
whatItIs: A white slide with a black, wobbly stacked wordmark 'plod.' whose letters melt into each other, followed by two applications: a black beanie with the mark embroidered in white, worn with headphones, and a black card with a reversed giant mark on crumpled silvery plastic.
whatItMeans: Cool, soft and youthful; distorted letters feel like a liquid streetwear brand.
techniques: Warp heavy letters into a wobbly liquid shape and stack them.
Keep it strictly black and white so it embroiders and prints cleanly.
Enlarge and crop the mark on small items like cards.

vocabulary.definition: Letters distorted into soft blobby shapes.
A name arranged on two lines.
A logo in white on black.
Application shown on a material with strong texture.
